title: GET /api/box/excluded-underlyings (200)
description: The operator blocklist. Source: src/box/engine.ts listExcludedUnderlyings(), which is also embedded verbatim as `excluded_underlyings` in box-status.schema.json so the dashboard needs no second request. TOP LEVEL IS CLOSED. The load state is part of the contract on purpose: a blocklist that cannot be READ is not an empty blocklist, so `readable: false` must be rendered as the reason no new box is being entered (it raises the `underlying_exclusions_unreadable` readiness blocker, scope `entry`), never as 'nothing is excluded'.

readable.description: Whether the blocklist may be relied on to decide a name is ALLOWED. False REFUSES all new entry. Note the asymmetry: an unreadable book can still prove a name is forbidden if it happens to hold it, but it can never prove one is permitted.

persistent.description: Whether an exclusion can be stored durably at all. False means the deployment has no box persistence, so no exclusion could ever have been saved and none is being forgotten — writes are refused rather than accepted and lost.

load_state.description: How the in-memory book came to hold what it holds. never_loaded and failed both refuse entry; loaded and unpersisted both permit it.

error.description: Why the last durable read failed, when it did. Bounded and safe to display; never SQL or a stack trace.

max.description: The most underlyings this deployment will hold on the blocklist (MAX_EXCLUDED_UNDERLYINGS).

excluded.description: Ordered by symbol, so a client and a test see a stable list.
